{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./tf2_train.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from PBS:
#   -l select=1:ncpus=1:ngpus=1 -> -N 1 -n 1 -c 1 -g 1
#   -l walltime=24:00:00        -> -t 24h
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -c 1 -g 1 -t 24h --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: PBS -P QCL_PT not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: accounting/charging may not be applied as intended; site may require project/account out-of-band.

  # NOTE: PBS -q defaultQ not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a queue/constraint mapping, the job may run on any eligible resources; you are not forcing the defaultQ queue.

  # NOTE: PBS mem=30GB not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a memory reservation/limit, the job may contend for memory or be OOM-killed, affecting reliability/performance.

  module load cuda/10.0.130
  module load openmpi-gcc/3.1.3

  source miniconda/bin/activate training

  cd models/ || exit 1

  flux run -n 1 -c 1 -g 1 \
    python research/object_detection/model_main_tf2.py \
      --model_dir="/project/RDS-FSC-QCL_PT-RW/rcnn_model_data/" \
      --num_train_steps=200000 \
      --sample_1_of_n_eval_examples=1 \
      --pipeline_config_path=pipeline.config \
      --alsologtostder
fi
"
}
